name: Ninja Head Survival
desc: A small, fast survival game that runs directly in the browser: play a ninja, throw shuriken at the approaching zombies, and see how long you can last. The zombies follow you, drain your health on touch, and arrive more frequently as time passes; when your health hits zero the run ends, scored by the zombies you defeated and the time you survived. Installable PWA, zero dependencies, no network calls.
controls: WASD/arrows move, click the arena to throw a shuriken at that point, Space or tap to start (touch: drag the joystick, tap ATTACK or tap the arena to aim)
creator: leonard331311-oss
